name: e28-soak-r2
reason: Both earlier soak attempts ran the final bundle and stay failed. final-r2 carries the lease read cap fix (horizon-22) and the registration refusal fix (horizon-23). This is the first measurement of final-r2, on the unchanged fixture.
fixture_unchanged: same logs on the same volume, proxy fallback at its defaults, same direct-bot routing
pass_line: crossings every minute, zero duplicated cargo, zero owner violations, no production process growing 10 percent or more from minute 5 to 30

fix_specific_readback.slow_renewals: every lease renewal whose reply took over 200 ms: count, maximum, whether it installed

on_failure: keep the row, diagnose from evidence and report. No rerun without a stated reason. A collection-only fault may get one explicitly named retry, e28-soak-r2-a1. A cluster failure may not.
